REPORT Date October 26, 19 38.
Subject Shanghai Science Institute (上海自然科學研究所) and
its connection with Siau Ts-ming.
Made by D.I. Pan Lien Fih Forwarded by
In connection with the Shanghai Science Institute,
320 Route Ghisi, enquiries show that it was established 13
years ago with funds appropriated from the Japanese portion
of the Boxer Indemnity to further interest in scientific
research. The Institute consists of seven Departments,
namely :-
(1) Department of Physics.
(2) Department of Chemistry.
(3) Department of Biology.
(4) Department of Geology.
(5) Department of Pathology.
(6) Department of Bacteriology.
(7) Department of Pharmaceutical Research.
Among the staff of the Institute, which is exclusively
Japanese, are a number of Technicians. The present
Director of the Institute is Mr. ISAKI (委崎), who
succeeded the late Mr. SINZO SHINJO (新城新藏), upon the
latter's demise early this year.
Chinese students of this branch of learning, re-
questing to join the Institute as research members, must
have the consent of the Director and in addition must be
either graduates of a Japanese University or returned students
from Japan Proper. Chinese research members of the
Institute are entitled to a monthly subsidy of (1) from $40
to $100 for ordinary research members and (2) from $100 to
$200 for senior research members, which can be had on appli-
cation, but the students are required to make a pledge that
they will explicitly maintain a pro-Japanese sentiment for life.
（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER 27 OCT. 1938 CRIME BRANCH）

S.l, 特别处 Shihm,
报告日期 1938年10月26日。
主题：上海自然科学研究所（上海自然科學研究所）及其与萧子明（Siau Ts-ming）的关联。
由副督察潘连璧（Pan Lien Fih）撰写 转呈

关于上海自然科学研究所，
地址为祁齐路（Route Ghisi）320号，调查显示该所成立于13年前，资金来源于庚子赔款的日本部分，旨在促进对科学研究的兴趣。该所下设七个部门，即：
(1) 物理部。
(2) 化学部。
(3) 生物部。
(4) 地质部。
(5) 病理部。
(6) 细菌学部。
(7) 药学研究部。

该所职员全为日本人，其中包括多名技术人员。现任所长为ISAKI先生（委崎），他于今年早些时候前任所长新城新藏（SINZO SHINJO）去世后继任。

希望以研究员身份加入该所的中国学生，必须获得所长同意，此外还必须是日本大学毕业或从日本本土归国的留学生。该所的中国研究员有权申请每月津贴，金额为：(1) 普通研究员40至100元；(2) 高级研究员100至200元，但要求学生宣誓终身明确保持亲日情绪。
（印：副警务总监 1938年10月27日 刑侦处）

Should the result of the studies carried out bring forth
any new inventions in any of the subjects mentioned
above, the academical degree of Doctor will accordingly
be conferred on the members concerned, by Tokyo, through
the offices of the Institute.

The Institute is generally considered to be an
organ where pro-Japanese training is given Chinese students
and pro-Japanese sentiment is cultivated, under the guise
of scientific research, and it is learned that there are
only a few Chinese students among the members, in spite of
the attractive terms offered.

There are approximately 50 Japanese subjects
residing on the premises, including resident members of
the Institute and Japanese citizens having no direct con-
nection with the Institute.

Enquiries have failed to establish any connection
which may have existed between the Institute and Siau Ts-ming
(蕭子明), alias Siau Ping-zung (蕭秉成), Chief of
the General Affairs Department of the International Dispensary,
who was assassinated on Honan Road on 1-10-38 and among whose
effects, two cards bearing the names Sinzo Shinjo and Tachu
Uyeno were later found. It is only known that Siau was a
returned law student from Japan, and prior to his death, served
as Secretary in one of the departments of the Reformed Govern-
ment, although ostensibly on the staff list of the International
Dispensary.

Enquiries made at request Pan Lien-pih

如果上述任何学科的研究成果产生任何新发明，东京方面将通过该研究所的相关机构，据此向有关成员授予博士学位。

该所普遍被认为是一个借科学研究之名，向中国学生提供亲日训练并培养亲日情绪的机构。据悉，尽管提供的条件颇具吸引力，但该所成员中的中国学生寥寥无几。

寓居在该所址内的日本臣民约有50人，包括该所的驻所成员以及与该所无直接关系的日本公民。

经调查，未能证实该所与国际药房总务处处长萧子明（Siau Ts-ming）（别名萧秉成 Siau Ping-zung）之间曾存在任何关联。萧于1938年10月1日在河南路被暗杀，在其遗物中后来发现了两张分别印有新城新藏（Sinzo Shinjo）和上野达夫（Tachu Uyeno）姓名的名片。目前仅知萧是一名从日本归国的法律系留学生，在去世前，虽名义上列职于国际药房职员名单，实则担任维新政府某部门的秘书。
